pages.text: A windmill stood in the field. None of its sails were moving.
Pongi lifted her head to look up. "I want to see it turn."
Pongi walked right up to the windmill. One sail was so low she could almost touch it.
Dad took a big breath. "I'll make it turn for you."
Whooo! Dad blew toward the windmill.
The sail didn't move at all. Only Dad's face turned red.
Just then, Dad's hat flew away. It rolled across the field.
The grass began to bend to one side. The windmill's sails moved with a creak.
The sails turned slowly. Dad ran after his hat.
